contributions.detail: delta 260.00, and the FORM'S OWN ARITHMETIC diagnoses it - nothing here was recomputed or overwritten. Schedule A's printed 'TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED' reads 'LOAN $7200.00'. On the Summary Page, line 3 (beginning balance) = $260.00 and line 4 ('Total Contributions Received, From Line 1 Column A') = $7,200.00, NOT the 7,460.00 the filer wrote on line 1. Both balance identities then close exactly with 7,200: line 3 + line 4 = line 5 (260.00 + 7,200.00 = 7,460.00, printed) and line 5 - line 6 = line 7 (7,460.00 - 6,984.80 = 475.20, printed). So the filer copied line 5's subtotal into line 1. The stated 7,460.00 is retained verbatim as required; the itemized 7,200.00 matches Schedule A and lines 4-7.

itemized.notes: A 3-page form delivered as a 4-page PDF: p1 cover, p2 Summary Page, p3 Schedule A, p4 Schedule B. Filer is Gary Ott, County Recorder. SCHEDULE A CONTAINS EXACTLY ONE ENTRY and it is a BRACE, not three rows: three date cells (6MAR06, 27MAR06, 27MAR06) are joined by a hand-drawn brace to one name block and ONE amount of $7,200.00 - the candidate's own loan to his campaign. The amount could not be split across the three dates without inventing figures, so one row is emitted with a blank date and needs_review=1. The 260.00 gap between Summary line 1 (7,460.00) and Schedule A (7,200.00) is the filer copying line 5 into line 1; the form's own balance identities close on 7,200.00 (see recon detail). One Schedule B date is printed WITHOUT A YEAR ('7MAR') and is left blank - the year was not filled in from the report date. This filer writes cents as a superscript over a rule throughout; those are transcribed with a decimal point and the convention is named in each row note. PRIVACY: no address exists to record - the Complete Mailing Address column is entirely blank (filer omission, not a redaction). 'TOTAL EXPENDITUTRES MADE' is the form's own printed typo.
